# cato_subscription_groups (Data Source)

The `cato_subscription_groups` data source fetches information about account notification subscription groups with optional filters. Returns a list of subscription groups matching the filter criteria, each with its referenced mailing lists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
## Providers ###
provider "cato" {
  baseurl    = "https://api.catonetworks.com/api/v1/graphql2"
  token      = var.cato_token
  account_id = var.account_id
}

### Data Source Usage ###

# Example: Read all subscription groups
data "cato_subscription_groups" "all" {}

# Example: Read subscription groups by name
data "cato_subscription_groups" "by_name" {
  name_filter = ["NOC Alerts", "Security Notifications"]
}

# Example: Read subscription groups by ID
data "cato_subscription_groups" "by_id" {
  id_filter = ["12345", "67890"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id_filter` (List of String) List of subscription group IDs to filter by
- `name_filter` (List of String) List of subscription group names to filter by

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of subscription groups matching the filter criteria (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Subscription group ID
- `mailing_list` (Attributes List) Mailing lists referenced by this subscription group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--mailing_list))
- `name` (String) Subscription group name

<a id="nestedatt--items--mailing_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.mailing_list`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Mailing list ID
- `name` (String) Mailing list name
